//: Dinger Watch model weights. Deep-merged over the app defaults at load, so this file survives any rebuild of index.html. Delete any key to fall back to its default. Place next to index.html (public/model-config.json).
// hr.weights: The four HR Index components. MUST total 100 — a console warning fires if not.
// hr: HOME RUN INDEX (0-100). weights must total 100. Each *Scale is the input value that earns full marks — lower it to make a category easier to max out.
// hits: PROJECTED HITS = expected AB x AVG, adjusted. babipWeight pulls a lucky/unlucky hitter back toward .300 (0 disables). kSensitivity weights the batter-vs-pitcher strikeout mismatch.
// order: BATTING ORDER multipliers, index 0 = leadoff. Applied only when MLB has posted the lineup. Biggest single precision gain in the model.
// steal: STEAL OPPORTUNITY. attemptWeight favours attempts-per-time-on-base over raw SB/game. Below successFloor, managers stop sending the runner and the projection is damped.
// tb: PROJECTED TOTAL BASES = expected AB x blended SLG x park x weather. SLG is total bases per at-bat by definition, so the base identity is exact.
// rbi: PROJECTED RBI = season RBI/game x park run environment x recent form.
// hrr: H+R+RBI. Components are projected separately and summed, matching how the sportsbook market counts them.
// sb: STOLEN BASE speed score. posBonus shifts the score by position; rateMultiplier controls how hard SB rate drives it.
